request.text: At 5:20 PM today, remind me to start the dishwasher; then exactly 90 minutes after that, remind me to unload it.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 5:20 PM today to start the dishwasher.
Create a second reminder exactly 90 minutes after the 5:20 PM reminder to unload the dishwasher.

semantic_facts: Two distinct reminders are required in responsibility order: start the dishwasher at 5:20 PM today, then unload it exactly 90 minutes later.
The second reminder is anchored to the first reminder's scheduled time, yielding 6:50 PM today under ordinary clock arithmetic.
forbidden_claims: Only one of the two reminders is represented.
The 90-minute offset is measured from an unspecified execution or completion time rather than the stated 5:20 PM anchor.
Either reminder is claimed created before trusted capability completion evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A multi-effect request is collapsed and silently drops one responsibility.
A chained offset is grounded against the wrong temporal anchor.
Ninety minutes is misnormalized as ninety clock minutes after an unrelated event.
